analysis.insight_summary: Initially, users were unsure about how to reference blocks, rather than just numbers, within mathematical function blocks in [product_name] [version_no]. After clarification, it was found to be a simple process, indicating that the interface or instructions might not make this feature obvious, which could affect how easily new users discover and learn about it.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expected to be able to reference other blocks within mathematical block parameters, rather than being limited to numeric inputs.
